key_insight: The paper compresses magnetic Moment Tensor Potentials using low-rank matrix and tensor factorizations, cutting model size by about 1.5–3× while preserving accuracy.
engineering_relevance: This enables cheaper, faster magnetic atomistic simulations for materials design without sacrificing predictive reliability for key structural, vibrational, and magnetic properties.
method: Apply matrix and tensor decompositions to the mMTP parameterization
Reduce the number of trainable parameters while keeping the same potential form
Validate the compressed model on Fe-Al and CrN molecular dynamics and property predictions
evidence_signal: The compressed potentials matched the original mMTP numerically on validation and produced simulation results consistent with DFT and experimental data for Fe-Al and CrN.
watch_item: Compression should be checked carefully for each target system because reduced parameterization can still affect transferability outside the tested materials and conditions.
paper_title: Compressed magnetic Moment Tensor Potentials via low-rank matrix and tensor factorizations
